@graph.name: Entry 13: the time model, finally tested — ascent half holds, descent bridge does not
@graph.text: The ascent half is empirically supported and transfers out-of-sample: the pre-declared endpoint T1b reaches 6.6% median vs the naive baseline's 7.6% on 441 P. Paz rides (sign test p = 0.011), concentrated on the hilliest tercile, and the physics k₊ beats a FITTED ceiling frozen on the new rider (6.6 vs 10.9). The descent bridge is NOT confirmed: the analytic ε↔k₋ form systematically over-predicts measured descent speed (corr 0.08–0.59) — real descents are behaviour- and cap-limited — so k₋ stays a free, corpus-dependent coefficient.
